summary: Inference latency regression after runtime 1.18 rollout (p95 +40–80%) impacting chat completions
description:
Issue summary:
- Customer reports significant latency regression after Redwood serving runtime 1.18 rollout.
- Observed across Chat Completions and Text Generation (non-streaming and streaming), with biggest impact on longer outputs.

Customer impact:
- Aurora Search reports production SLO breach on end-user search-assistant flows.
- Symptoms: p95 latency increased ~40–80% depending on model; elevated tail latency spikes (p99) during peak.
- No material increase in 5xx, but increased client-side timeouts due to slower responses.

Scope / blast radius (initial):
- Regions: us-east (strongest), eu-west (moderate).
- Models most impacted: rw-llama-70b-instruct (highest), rw-llama-8b-instruct, rw-mistral-7b-instruct.
- Endpoints: /v1/chat/completions, /v1/completions.

Timeline (UTC):
- 2026-02-13 17:52: Customer email + ticket opened. Customer notes issue began “shortly after” runtime update.
- 18:05: Support confirms internal dashboards show p95 regression coincident with runtime 1.18 deploy wave.
- 18:12: Slack bridge started in #support per playbook; moved to #incidents when multi-customer pattern confirmed.
- 18:25: SRE on-call (Sean Gallagher) engaged; Release on-call looped in via #eng-releases.
- 19:10: Initial mitigation: halt further rollout; shift traffic away from 1.18 pools where possible.
- 20:05: Partial rollback in us-east Dedicated/Hosted pools; latency begins recovering.
- 2026-02-14 00:40: Full rollback completed in us-east; eu-west rollback completed 02:10.
- 2026-02-14 03:00: p95 back to baseline (+/- 5%) on key dashboards; customer confirms recovery.

Environment details requested/received:
- Customer SDK: redwood-sdk-typescript 2.6.1
- Traffic pattern: mix of streaming and non-streaming; typical output 300–900 tokens
- Customer regions: us-east primary, eu-west backup
- Example request IDs (customer provided):
  - req_01HZZ9Z2S5KJ9A3FQ4VQ9K2E7W
  - req_01HZZB0P7R9ZQK8A6T6F1P3N2M

Steps to reproduce (internal):
1) In prod, send chat completion to rw-llama-70b-instruct with max_tokens=700, temperature=0.2.
2) Compare identical prompt on runtime 1.17 pools vs 1.18 pools.
3) Observe time-to-first-token (TTFT) and time-per-output-token (TPOT) deltas; tail increases on 1.18.

Diagnostics / investigation notes:
- Correlation: regression lines up with runtime 1.18 deployment window (deploy label runtime_version=1.18).
- Metrics: TTFT modestly worse (~10–15%), but TPOT and queueing latency increased notably under load.
- Hypotheses (SRE/Runtime):
  - Continuous batching behavior change causing smaller effective batch sizes (lower GPU utilization, higher scheduling overhead).
  - KV cache memory pressure leading to more frequent evictions / recompute under longer sequences.
  - Scheduler fairness changes increasing queue time for long generations.

Dashboards (internal):
- Latency overview: grafana://prod/inference-latency?var-region=us-east&var-model=rw-llama-70b-instruct
- TTFT/TPOT breakdown: grafana://prod/streaming-health?var-region=us-east
- Queueing and GPU util: grafana://prod/cluster-utilization?var-region=us-east&var-pool=hosted

Escalation/coordination:
- Support bridge started: #support-bridge-inc-2026-02-13-latency
- Incident channel: #incidents (INC-2026-02-13-ue1-euw-latency)
- Owner (technical): SRE on-call (Sean Gallagher) coordinating rollback with release on-call.
- Customer comms owner: Rachel Kim for enterprise cadence; Support to relay technical updates.

Customer comms notes:
- We acknowledged regression, avoided promising RCA until confirmed.
- Provided mitigation status updates while rollback in progress (approx hourly cadence during active mitigation).

Requested follow-ups:
- Runtime team to identify 1.18 change causing TPOT/queue regression and add guardrail / perf test.
- Docs/Support: add a short internal troubleshooting note for “latency regression after deploy” including how to quickly check runtime_version and pool routing.

Sensitivity:
- Do not include customer query text/prompt content in broadly visible docs. Request IDs are OK for internal troubleshooting.
comments:
2026-02-13 18:07 (Priya Shah): Confirmed spike on inference latency dashboard for us-east starting ~17:40 UTC. Creating bridge per playbook and paging SRE if we confirm multi-customer impact. Asking customer for 3 request IDs, region, model, and whether streaming.
2026-02-13 18:16 (Owen Phillips): Pulled logs for req_01HZZ9Z2S5KJ9A3FQ4VQ9K2E7W. No 5xx; end-to-end latency increased with longer generation. Noted runtime_version=1.18 tag on the serving pods handling the request. Looping in #eng-oncall.
2026-02-13 18:28 (Sean Gallagher): Seeing same pattern across a few tenants (not just Aurora). Treating as Sev2 until we confirm if all regions affected. Pausing further rollout of 1.18; evaluating rollback vs config revert.
2026-02-13 19:14 (Rachel Kim): Sent customer update: we identified regression correlating with a runtime rollout; mitigation underway; next update within 60 minutes. No RCA promised yet.
2026-02-13 20:12 (Sean Gallagher): Rollback started in us-east hosted pool. Early signs: p95 improving. Will proceed with eu-west next if stable. Please keep customer comms aligned to mitigation status (rollback in progress).
2026-02-14 02:21 (Owen Phillips): Customer confirms p95 back to normal range in us-east; eu-west improving. Marking ticket as mitigated pending 24h monitoring.
2026-02-16 16:40 (Owen Phillips): 48h check: latency stable and back to baseline. Closing as Resolved. Action item remains for runtime team to root cause 1.18 regression and add perf guardrails before re-roll.
resolution:
Mitigation: halted rollout of runtime 1.18 and performed rollback to 1.17 in affected prod pools (us-east, eu-west). Latency returned to baseline within ~8 hours of mitigation start; customer confirmed recovery.

Customer-facing outcome:
- No customer-side changes required.
- Provided enterprise update cadence during mitigation; final follow-up confirming recovery and next steps.

Next steps (internal):
- Runtime team RCA + fix and re-release plan for 1.18 follow-up.
- Add release guardrail: automated canary comparison of TPOT/queue latency under representative long-generation load before broad rollout.
- Ensure Support has a quick-check dashboard link set (see ENG-4823) including runtime_version breakdown.
